revisions.prompt: At 0.00 seconds, fully reference the supplied opening sign and upright mink. Preserve the exact two-line AN AGENT FOR THE / OPEN-SOURCE AI ART ECOSYSTEM lettering, stepped border corners, raised paws, face, tail-left silhouette, sparse red-orange ground pixels, centered scale, and broad pure-black margins. Flat 2D orange pixel art only: hard square edges, restricted orange/amber palette, black cutouts; no photorealism, 3D, soft fur, gradients, glow, scenery, camera motion, or invented objects. First let the paws settle while the sign remains perfectly readable. Then the mink plants its feet, pivots right, and performs a clear four-legged run with alternating legs and short stepped tail arcs. The sign border and letters disassemble into deliberate square tiles, travel in orderly paths, and reassemble into the exact TWO IDEAS heading and two panels of the destination. Land on the v04 composition: TOOLS & STRUCTURES bright on the left, COLLECTIVE KNOWLEDGE dim and readable on the right; wrench held forward, connector floating above, linked-node pack on the back, tail right. Keep every tile orange on black, keep all negative space empty, and hold the final v04 arrangement for the last beat.

Begin from the exact v04 still: TWO IDEAS centered; bright TOOLS & STRUCTURES left panel; dim COLLECTIVE KNOWLEDGE right panel; upright left-facing mink with wrench extended, connector overhead, linked-node pack on its back, tail to the right. Preserve all lettering and panel borders as hard-edged pixel art. In the first beat, the mink drops from upright into a low rightward run; the wrench, connector, and pack detach as distinct square orange tiles without melting into the body. Then let those tiles become a few sparse document, node, bulb, and code icons that follow curved dotted paths. The mink continues running with leg alternation and a visible tail cycle while the left panel gradually dims and the right panel gradually brightens. Finish on the exact v05 arrangement: one low horizontal right-facing runner, tail left, restrained head glow, sparse separated dotted streams and the documented icon set. Keep the heading and panels stable and legible, leave black gaps untouched, and reserve empty upper/side regions for compositing. Flat 2D orange pixel art only; no grayscale collage, photographic/document background, scenery, solid orange curtains or bars, volumetric light, extra characters, text generation, camera move, zoom, or soft edges.

Start with the supplied v05 composition: one low right-facing orange mink running across the lower middle, tail left, dim TOOLS & STRUCTURES panel, bright COLLECTIVE KNOWLEDGE panel, TWO IDEAS heading, and sparse curved dotted streams with only the documented document, node, bulb, and code icons. Keep running immediately; never freeze the source mink. Over the first beats, narrow and disperse the streams into small square particles while the runner brakes near center and rises through a readable crouch-to-stand. Two separate companion minks enter from opposite sides as simple orange pixel silhouettes. Resolve to the exact v12 tableau: three independent minks in a loose triangle, large left pointing right, smaller higher center pointing left, large right pointing left; each retains its bent second paw, ears, round black eyes, tail direction, and relative scale. Remove panels, heading, streams, icons, glow, and ground shadow cleanly into pure black. Keep generous black separation between bodies. No fourth mink, fused limbs, duplicated paws, merged tails, extra props, scenery, grayscale background, soft light columns, photorealism, 3D, camera movement, zoom, or text mutation.

Start from the exact three-mink pointing triangle with all three bodies separate. Immediately retract paws, turn heads, bend knees, and launch all three into a coordinated rightward run. Keep the upper three quarters and left side pure black for the terminal overlay. The left and center minks exit right first; the remaining mink keeps running and gradually reduces to the small lower-right scale without stretching, melting, or duplicating limbs. Only then assemble the small desk, thin black monitor, orange chair, and seated left-facing typing mink in the lower-right corner. Finish on the exact terminal_v1_background geometry: black text-free monitor, two desk legs, chair behind the mink, tail extending right along the floor, every other region black. Flat hard-edged orange pixel art only; no new text, room, scenery, extra characters, glow, camera move, zoom, or background contamination.

Begin from the exact terminal-v1-background lower-right vignette while preserving the desk, black monitor, chair, tail, and empty black field. The mink finishes one short typing cycle, looks toward screen right, pulls its paws from the keyboard, stands, and runs decisively off the right edge with compact alternating pixel legs and a readable tail bob. Do not erase the mink by morphing, dissolving, shrinking into noise, or dropping opacity. Keep the desk, monitor, and chair stable during the first half of the exit; then let the entire small vignette clear naturally with the runner, leaving a pure black picture field for the final beat. End on the supplied black-frame picture endpoint. The terminal-background overlay is independent and must not be generated, covered, or given new text.
